lines.en: I creep along the rock wall.

lines.zh: 洞里只有我自己的回声。
lines.en: Only my own echo fills the cave.
I walk past a heap of coal.
It crunches under my feet.
I walk hunched over.
The ceiling is low here.
I follow the ore vein.
Firelight ahead.
I shift the pick to the other hand.
I pause at the fork.
I go deeper.
The walls are all black soot.

lines.zh: 我踩过的洞壁，都留下一道煤黑。
lines.en: Every cave wall I brush past keeps a smear of coal.
I climb onto the stone ledge.

lines.zh: 我回头看有没有人跟来。
lines.en: I glance back to see if anyone follows.
I wipe the soot off the wall with my hand.
I crouch by the stone without moving.
I tap once. The sound is dull.
This may be empty.
I prop the pick on the ground.
It's cool in the cave.
I wipe my face, making it blacker.
The coal in my sack clinks.
This layer is good.
I tap the rock face again.
This one's hard. Not easy to mine.
I sit and rest a while.
I'll dig again later.
I know which way the coal is.

lines.zh: 头顶的钟乳石，滴着凉水。
lines.en: Cold water drips from the stalactites above.
The pick handle is a little loose.
I count how many torches are left.
You came down too?
This isn't a good place.
Your torch stings my eyes.
Don't step on my coal pile.
I've been digging down here a long while.

lines.zh: 你身后的火把，照得我眯眼。
lines.en: The torch behind you makes me squint.
My hands are all soot.
Which way are you headed?

lines.zh: 你脸上有煤灰，跟我一样。
lines.en: There is coal dust on your face, like mine.
I mean nothing by it.
Can what you're holding be traded?

lines.zh: 我背的袋子里全是煤渣。
lines.en: My sack is all coal grit.

lines.zh: 你的镐尖磕在我的腰上。
lines.en: Your pick tip caught my side.
A layer of dust fell off me.
I clutch my coal sack tighter.
I steady myself on the wall.
The cave echoes a lot.
I nearly dropped my pick.

lines.zh: 洞里的回声，全是我自己的。
lines.en: Every echo in this cave is my own.
I back into the dark.

lines.zh: 洞里磕碰惯了，不算什么。
lines.en: I am used to bumping around caves.
I still have digging to do.
Can that thing in your hand be eaten?

lines.zh: 煤灰糊在我脸上，我饿得慌。
lines.en: Coal dust cakes my face, and I am starving.
Give me a little.
There's little to eat in here.
I've been digging all day.
What you hold smells wonderful.
May I sit closer?
You can't finish all that, can you.
I'll trade coal for it.
This is good coal.
I set my pick down.
Sit down and eat with me.
I rarely meet anyone with food.
Nothing but stone and coal down here.
My stomach is growling loud.
I won't ask for much. One bite.
You bumped me in the narrow passage.
My hands are covered in soot.
Don't rub against me. Clothes go black.
The tunnel's too narrow to step aside.
I squeezed to one side.
Your shoulder hit my pick.
The coal in my pocket weighs more than my life.

lines.zh: 洞穴里黑，你踩着我的靴。
lines.en: It is dark in the cave and you step on my boot.
Only one of us fits here.
Step back a bit so I can pass.
I'm the only one in here.
I don't really understand that.
I'm too dirty.
That makes me embarrassed.
I've dug here for years.
There's a companion deeper down.
Keep your voice down.
The echo is too loud.
Let's talk about it later.
I need to get back to work.
This is coal.
This lump of coal is heavier than my fist.
Enough to burn a night.
I'll hold what you dropped.
Shiny things are rare down here.
I stuff it in my bag.
This stone won't budge.
I'll haul it later.
I'll remember the spot.
Don't lose it.
There's knocking over there.
That wasn't me.
I stop my pick.
It's the stone creaking.
Maybe the vein is splitting.
I edge that way.
The crack in the wall widened.
I need to be careful.
There are things in this cave.
I raise my pick.
I approach the crack slowly.
It's very dark inside.
I lower the torch.
The light only reaches halfway.
A knocking echo in the rock wall.
I hear breathing.
It isn't mine.
Following the seam, I probe each step.
The gravel underfoot is loud.
It hasn't moved.
I swing the pick.
It struck stone and sparks flew.
That one hit something soft.
I struck again.
I swing my pick and it lands by your feet.

lines.zh: 我的力气都用在挖煤上。
lines.en: All my strength goes into mining.
Every lump of coal in this cave is mine.
That pick split into a rock seam.
I duck behind the coal heap.
The pick is all I know.

lines.zh: 我从深处的坑道爬上来。
lines.en: I climb up from the deep shaft.
I'm covered in coal dust.
The air here is stale.
I shoulder the pick.
Someone else left this torch.
I followed the ore vein here.
There's a long way up.
I'm used to this place.
I sit and catch my breath.
The ceiling's low. I keep my head down.
Fire in a cave is frightening.

lines.zh: 从石台上摔下来，我滚到坑里。
lines.en: I fell off the ledge into the pit.

lines.zh: 地下水冰凉，我呛了一口。
lines.en: The groundwater is icy. I swallowed some.
The blast shook loose falling stones.
An arrow stuck in the rock wall.

lines.zh: 光在洞里散开，我的眼睛疼。
lines.en: Light spread in the cave and hurt my eyes.
My rations have run out.

lines.zh: 雷声从洞口滚进来，我缩起来。
lines.en: Thunder rolled in from the mouth of the cave. I shrank down.

lines.zh: 这下面太深，我看不见底。
lines.en: It's too deep. I can't see the bottom.
